text:
maria: CI failing on the docs site for /guides/migrations — netlify build error + a redirect loop, can someone triage?

deploy-bot: build failure: docs-site/netlify (job 423)
```
Error: Duplicate heading id 'note' in /guides/migrations.md
Redirect loop detected: /guides/old-link -> /guides/migrations#overview -> /guides/old-link
Exit code: 1
```

aj: I can take a look. My guess is our MDX remark plugin turned an admonition title into an explicit heading id which collides with an existing H2.

maria: thanks. Also the SDK snippet on that page uses the old client import (redwood-sdk v0) — needs updating to the new package and call pattern in the same PR.

aj: planning to do a small 3-part patch: (1) normalize admonition -> explicit id (e.g. `::: note id="migrations-note"`), (2) add a temporary redirect rule to break the loop, (3) update the SDK snippet to the v1 import and example. I'll open a PR and request reviews.

dan: heads up — the i18n branch has a translated version of that page where the heading casing differs, so slug collisions could reappear post-merge. @olga can you sync on slug regen after we merge?

olga: yep — once the main fix lands I'll run the i18n slugify job and push a follow-up PR for locales if needed. Please add a note in the PR description asking me to run it.

aj: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8142 with the three fixes. CI passes locally; netlify build queued. PTAL @maria @dan. Summary in PR: updated admonition id, added a redirect patch to netlify/_redirects, updated SDK example to `from @redwood/inference-client` and new call pattern.

maria: quick review done, left a tiny nit about specifying `js` on the fenced codeblock. :thumbsup:

docs-ci: netlify build started for PR #8142 (job 427)

docs-ci: netlify: Build succeeded for PR #8142. Redirect rule applied. Comment left on PR: "Please run i18n-slug regen after merge (cc @olga)"

maria: merging now. @olga after you regen slugs can we kick the nightly linkcheck job? If that passes we'll close the thread.

olga: will do, ETA ~30m. I'll post results here.

dan: thanks all. Small follow-up item: I'll add a unit check to our linkcheck harness to detect redirect loops (if a URL appears twice in the redirect chain mark as fail). Will open a follow-up PR for that.

maria: perfect — thanks everyone, closing the loop once linkcheck green. :rocket:
